local_context.value: Levy is an unincorporated community in southern Jasper County at 13 ft elevation, reached by SC Highway 315; Jasper County: 22.6% of residents 65+, 89.1% rural (2020 census).

permit_office.value: Jasper County Planning and Building (358 Third Ave, Ridgeland; 843-717-3650) issues permits throughout the County; Levy is unincorporated, so no town permit office applies
